notes.title: More steam achievements
notes.content:
1. Medal of Valor 🥇

Unlock Condition: Achieve 1st place in an online match or leaderboard.

2. Silver Cross 🥈

Unlock Condition: Achieve 2nd place in an online match or leaderboard.

3. Bronze Star 🥉

Unlock Condition: Achieve 3rd place in an online match or leaderboard.

4. Top Ten Tactical 🎖️

Unlock Condition: Place in the top 10 of the online leaderboard.

notes.title: New Online Leaderboard
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, thank you for the continued support of Flak![/p][p]There is now a new online score screen and an online ranking once you have defeated all of the blimps on the campaign [/p][p]Additionally some audio improvements and bugs have been ironed out.[/p][p][/p][p]All feedback is welcomed :)[/p]

notes.title: Battle for the Top! Online Multiplayer Showdown Coming Soon! 🏆🎮
notes.content:
Exciting news for our gaming community! 


We're thrilled to announce that soon, you'll be able to challenge friends and foes alike in our upcoming online multiplayer mode. 

Dive into intense battles, outsmart your opponents, and climb your way up to claim the top ranking position. 

Ready to prove your prowess? 

Stay tuned for more updates and prepare for the ultimate showdown! 🎮🏆

notes.title: Small fix version 1.2
notes.content:
The list of bugs below are early finds. In addition to the bug fixes, there is now also a NEW campaign completion online high score screen. Good luck!

Bug fixes:

- Diver bomber would cause the game to crash sometimes
- Crashes associated to pressing "N" to continue
- Crashes associate with launch button and land to sea tiles
- More minor issues that are not critical to game-play

Latest version: 1.2


- Adrian
